Is the emitter to base PN junction forward biased?
To forward bias a PN junction, the P material must be more
positive than the N type material. The base of NPN transistor is P
and the emitter is N. If Eb is more positive than Ee, then the
emitter to base PN junction is forward biased.

Is the collector to base PN junction reverse biased?
To reverse bias a PN junction, the P material must be more
negative than the N type material. The base of NPN transistor is
P and the collector is N. If Eb is more negative than Ec, then the
collector to base PN junction is reverse biased.
